name: Arvin Marketing Pro

layouts.cover: Carousel cover: huge gold uppercase headline, page number, gold half-circle with arrow. Use for the first slide of a how-to or tips post.
layouts.list: Numbered list: gold label tag, bold white headline, 3-5 numbered rows. Use for tips, steps, checklists.
layouts.question: Question/statement: tall condensed white uppercase headline with an underline. Use for hooks and questions.
layouts.card: Email card: white card with headline, short body and a gold 'New Email Received' pill. Use for email-marketing or story-style posts.

voice: Friendly, practical and encouraging. Short sentences. No jargon. Light use of emojis.
